subject: Confirmation of Dinner Reservation
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your dinner reservation for two at our restaurant this Saturday at 7:00 PM. Your table will be located by the window with a beautiful view of the city. We look forward to welcoming you and hope you have a delightful dining experience with us. If you have any special requests or need to make changes, please feel free to contact us. Best regards, The Restaurant Team
